question_en: Which pairing correctly places Andhra Pradesh in the current WII biogeographic scheme?
question_te: ప్రస్తుత WII biogeographic schemeలో Andhra Pradeshకు సరైన pairing ఏది?

options_en.a: Coastal plain—Province 8B East Coast; parts of Eastern Ghats—Province 6C Eastern Highlands

options_te.a: Coastal plain—Province 8B East Coast; Eastern Ghatsలో కొన్ని parts—Province 6C Eastern Highlands

explanation_en: The coastal plain belongs to Zone 8/Province 8B, while parts of the Eastern Ghats belong to Zone 6/Province 6C.
explanation_te: Coastal plain Zone 8లోని Province 8Bకు; Eastern Ghatsలో కొన్ని parts Zone 6లోని Province 6Cకు చెందుతాయి.

question_en: Why may both 974 km and 1,053.07 km appear as Andhra Pradesh coastline figures?
question_te: Andhra Pradesh coastlineకు 974 km, 1,053.07 km అనే రెండు figures ఎందుకు కనిపించవచ్చు?

options_en.a: One includes rivers and the other excludes the Bay of Bengal
options_en.b: They come from different measurement methods and assessment dates

options_te.a: ఒకటి riversను include చేస్తుంది, మరొకటి Bay of Bengalను exclude చేస్తుంది
options_te.b: అవి different measurement methods, assessment datesకు చెందినవి

explanation_en: The revised 1,053.07 km figure replaced the older roughly 974 km measurement; the method and date must accompany the number.
explanation_te: Revised 1,053.07 km figure పాత సుమారు 974 km measurementను replace చేసింది. Numberతో పాటు method, dateను చూడాలి.

question_en: An old text labels the coastal zone as Zone 10, while the current WII scheme labels Coasts as Zone 8. What is the sound conclusion?
question_te: Old text coastal zoneను Zone 10గా, current WII scheme Coastsను Zone 8గా చూపితే సరైన conclusion ఏది?

options_en.a: One number must be a printing error
options_en.b: Zone numbers must be interpreted with the classification version
options_en.c: Zone 8 and Zone 10 are geographical synonyms
options_en.d: The current scheme has no Islands zone

options_te.b: Zone numberను classification versionతో కలిపి interpret చేయాలి

explanation_en: Numbering changed between schemes. In the current scheme, Zone 8 is Coasts and Zone 10 is Islands.
explanation_te: Schemes మారినప్పుడు numbering మారింది. Current schemeలో Zone 8 Coasts, Zone 10 Islands.

question_en: Which combination best characterises the Eastern Ghats in Andhra Pradesh relative to the Western Ghats?
question_te: Western Ghatsతో పోలిస్తే Andhra Pradeshలో Eastern Ghatsను bestగా describe చేసే combination ఏది?

options_en.b: Lower, drier and discontinuous, with major rivers cutting across

options_te.b: Lower, drier, discontinuous; major rivers వీటిని cut across చేస్తాయి

explanation_en: The Eastern Ghats are lower, drier and broken into ranges; the Godavari and Krishna cross them.
explanation_te: Eastern Ghats lower, drier, discontinuous rangesగా ఉంటాయి; Godavari, Krishna rivers వీటిని దాటుతాయి.

question_en: A restoration agency proposes dense tree planting across native Rayalaseema grassland. What is the principal ecological objection?
question_te: Native Rayalaseema grassland అంతటా dense tree planting చేయాలని restoration agency ప్రతిపాదించింది. ప్రధాన ecological objection ఏది?

options_en.a: Every grassland must first become a desert
options_en.b: Native grassland is an open ecosystem, so unsuitable planting may damage its habitat and species
options_en.c: Trees can grow only on the coast

options_te.b: Native grassland ఒక open ecosystem; unsuitable planting దాని habitat, speciesను damage చేయవచ్చు

explanation_en: Restoration must match the ecosystem. Grassland is not vacant land awaiting afforestation.
explanation_te: Restoration ecosystemకు సరిపోవాలి. Grassland అనేది afforestation కోసం ఖాళీగా ఉన్న land కాదు.

question_en: Which statement correctly distinguishes forest cover from tree cover in Indian assessments?
question_te: Indian assessmentsలో forest cover, tree cover మధ్య correct distinction ఏది?

options_en.a: Forest cover depends only on legal notification; tree cover occurs only inside forests
options_en.b: Forest cover uses prescribed canopy and area criteria irrespective of legal status; tree cover refers to tree-covered patches outside recorded forests
options_en.d: Tree cover includes only orchards and forest cover only plantations

options_te.a: Forest cover legal notificationపై మాత్రమే ఆధారపడుతుంది; tree cover forestsలో మాత్రమే ఉంటుంది
options_te.b: Forest cover prescribed canopy, area criteria ఆధారంగా legal statusతో సంబంధం లేకుండా గుర్తిస్తారు; tree cover recorded forests బయట tree-covered patchesను సూచిస్తుంది
options_te.d: Tree cover orchards మాత్రమే; forest cover plantations మాత్రమే

explanation_en: The categories use different definitions and their figures belong to particular assessment periods.
explanation_te: ఈ categoriesకు definitions వేరు; వాటి figures కూడా specific assessment periodsకు చెందినవి.

question_en: Why is NSTR not added as a fourteenth Wildlife Sanctuary or a fourth National Park in Andhra Pradesh totals?
question_te: Andhra Pradesh totalsలో NSTRను 14th Wildlife Sanctuary లేదా 4th National Parkగా ఎందుకు add చేయరు?

options_en.a: Tiger Reserves have no legal basis
options_en.b: Its Tiger Reserve layer overlaps existing protected areas rather than forming an extra National Park or Sanctuary
options_en.d: It is only a bird area

options_te.b: Tiger Reserve layer existing protected areasపై overlap అవుతుంది; extra National Park లేదా Sanctuary కాదు

explanation_en: Protected-area category counts and the Tiger Reserve management layer answer different questions.
explanation_te: Protected-area category count, Tiger Reserve management layer వేర్వేరు విషయాలు. Overlapను duplicate siteగా count చేయకూడదు.

question_en: Match the two Rajiv Gandhi protected areas correctly.
question_te: Rajiv Gandhi పేరున్న రెండు protected areasను correctly match చేయండి.

options_en.a: National Park—Rameswaram beside Penna; Wildlife Sanctuary—Nallamala and part of NSTR
options_en.b: National Park—Nallamala; Wildlife Sanctuary—Rameswaram beside Penna
options_en.d: Both are alternative names for NSTR

options_te.a: National Park—Penna పక్కన Rameswaram; Wildlife Sanctuary—Nallamalaలో, NSTRలో భాగం
options_te.b: National Park—Nallamala; Wildlife Sanctuary—Penna పక్కన Rameswaram

explanation_en: The small National Park is at Rameswaram in YSR Kadapa; the larger Wildlife Sanctuary lies in the Nallamala landscape.
explanation_te: Small National Park YSR Kadapaలోని Rameswaram వద్ద ఉంది; larger Wildlife Sanctuary Nallamala landscapeలో ఉంది.

question_en: Why can the ecological effect of Polavaram on Papikonda extend beyond the directly submerged area?
question_te: Papikondaపై Polavaram ecological effect directly submerged area దాటి ఎందుకు విస్తరించవచ్చు?

options_en.a: Only because park tourism may fall
options_en.b: Altered flow and riverside forest loss may disrupt wildlife movement and north–south connectivity
options_en.c: Because Papikonda is an island ecosystem
options_en.d: Because all Eastern Ghats forest is legally submerged

options_te.b: Altered flow, riverside forest loss వల్ల wildlife movement, north–south connectivity disrupt కావచ్చు
options_te.d: Eastern Ghats forest మొత్తం legally submerged కాబట్టి

explanation_en: Connectivity effects can spread through the landscape even when a location is not itself underwater.
explanation_te: ఒక location నీటిలో మునగకపోయినా landscape connectivity దెబ్బతినడం వల్ల wider ecological effects రావచ్చు.

options_en.a: Telineelapuram and Telukunchi are notified Wildlife Sanctuaries
options_en.b: Nelapattu is a notified Wildlife Sanctuary known for a pelican breeding colony
options_en.c: Kambalakonda protects a three-state elephant landscape
options_en.d: Koundinya is an urban forest beside Visakhapatnam

options_te.b: Nelapattu, pelican breeding colonyకు ప్రసిద్ధ notified Wildlife Sanctuary
options_te.c: Kambalakonda three-state elephant landscapeను protect చేస్తుంది

explanation_en: Telineelapuram and Telukunchi are recognised bird areas, Koundinya is linked to the elephant landscape, and Kambalakonda lies beside Visakhapatnam.
explanation_te: Telineelapuram, Telukunchi bird areas; Koundinya elephant landscapeలో భాగం; Kambalakonda Visakhapatnam పక్కన ఉంది.

question_en: A habitat-suitability model finds suitable bustard habitat near Rollapadu but field teams record no birds during one survey. Which conclusion is justified?
question_te: Habitat-suitability model Rollapadu సమీపంలో suitable bustard habitat చూపింది; ఒక surveyలో field teamsకు birds కనిపించలేదు. Justified conclusion ఏది?

options_en.a: The model proves a positive population count
options_en.b: One non-detection formally proves local extinction
options_en.c: Suitability, field census and formal local-extinction evidence are different; stronger sustained surveys are needed
options_en.d: Habitat suitability means the sanctuary has no conservation value

options_te.a: Model positive population countను prove చేస్తుంది
options_te.b: ఒక non-detection local extinctionను formally prove చేస్తుంది
options_te.c: Suitability, field census, formal local-extinction evidence వేరు; stronger sustained surveys అవసరం
options_te.d: Habitat suitability అంటే sanctuaryకు conservation value లేదు

explanation_en: A model predicts habitat conditions; it does not count animals. A formal local-extinction claim requires sustained evidence.
explanation_te: Model habitat conditionsను predict చేస్తుంది; animalsను count చేయదు. Formal local-extinction claimకు sustained evidence అవసరం.

question_en: Assertion (A): NSTR and Amrabad can remain one ecological landscape despite being administered by different states. Reason (R): Continuous Nallamala forest permits tiger movement across the administrative boundary.
question_te: Assertion (A): Different states manage చేసినప్పటికీ NSTR, Amrabad ఒక ecological landscapeగా కొనసాగవచ్చు. Reason (R): Continuous Nallamala forest వల్ల tigers administrative boundary దాటి move అవుతాయి.

options_en.a: Both A and R are true, and R correctly explains A
options_en.b: Both A and R are true, but R does not explain A
options_en.c: A is true, R is false
options_en.d: A is false, R is true

options_te.a: A, R రెండూ true; R, Aను correctly explain చేస్తుంది
options_te.b: A, R రెండూ true; కానీ R, Aను explain చేయదు

explanation_en: Ecological connectivity follows habitat continuity and animal movement, not merely administrative borders.
explanation_te: Ecological connectivity administrative bordersకన్నా habitat continuity, animal movementపై ఆధారపడుతుంది.

question_en: Which is the best source-controlled reading of Andhra Pradesh tiger figures?
question_te: Andhra Pradesh tiger figuresకు best source-controlled reading ఏది?

options_en.a: AITE 2022's 63 is an NSTR-only count and can be averaged with 76 and 87
options_en.b: AITE 2022's 63 is for the state; the 2024 figures 76 and 87 are separate NSTR source claims and must not be merged
options_en.c: All three numbers measure India as a whole
options_en.d: The highest number automatically becomes official

options_te.a: AITE 2022లో 63 NSTR-only count; దాన్ని 76, 87తో average చేయవచ్చు
options_te.b: AITE 2022లో 63 state మొత్తం figure; 2024లో 76, 87 separate NSTR source claims, వాటిని merge చేయకూడదు
options_te.c: మూడు numbers India మొత్తాన్ని measure చేస్తాయి

explanation_en: Geographic scope, source and assessment cycle must remain attached to each figure.
explanation_te: ప్రతి figureతో geographic scope, source, assessment cycleను కలిపి ఉంచాలి.

question_en: Which statement correctly describes Seshachalam Biosphere Reserve?
question_te: Seshachalam Biosphere Reserve గురించి correct statement ఏది?

options_en.a: National designation automatically placed it in UNESCO's World Network
options_en.b: It has a national designation, but national designation and UNESCO inscription are separate
options_en.c: It is only an unapproved proposal
options_en.d: UNESCO inscription must precede national designation

options_te.a: National designationతో automatically UNESCO World Networkలో చేరింది
options_te.b: దానికి national designation ఉంది; కానీ national designation, UNESCO inscription separate processes
options_te.d: National designationకు ముందు UNESCO inscription తప్పనిసరి

explanation_en: Seshachalam is nationally designated but is not currently inscribed in UNESCO's World Network.
explanation_te: Seshachalam nationally designated; కానీ ప్రస్తుతం UNESCO World Networkలో inscribe కాలేదు.

question_en: Assertion (A): Red sanders being in CITES Appendix II does not mean that every international trade transaction is automatically prohibited. Reason (R): Appendix II generally regulates international trade through a permit system.
question_te: Assertion (A): Red sanders CITES Appendix IIలో ఉండటం వల్ల ప్రతి international trade transaction automaticగా prohibited కాదు. Reason (R): Appendix II సాధారణంగా permit system ద్వారా international tradeను regulate చేస్తుంది.

options_en.a: Both A and R are true, and R correctly explains A
options_en.b: Both A and R are true, but R does not explain A
options_en.c: A is true, R is false
options_en.d: A is false, R is true

options_te.a: A, R రెండూ true; R, Aను correctly explain చేస్తుంది
options_te.b: A, R రెండూ true; కానీ R, Aను explain చేయదు

explanation_en: Appendix II is a regulated-trade category. Illegal felling or trade without required permissions remains an offence.
explanation_te: Appendix II regulated-trade category. Required permissions లేకుండా illegal felling లేదా trade offenceగానే ఉంటుంది.

question_en: Which statement best distinguishes an endemic species from a native species?
question_te: Endemic species, native species మధ్య best distinction ఏది?

options_en.a: Every native species is confined to one small region
options_en.b: An endemic species is naturally restricted to a defined region; a native species occurs naturally there but may also occur elsewhere
options_en.d: Native and endemic are exact synonyms

options_te.a: ప్రతి native species ఒక small regionకే confined
options_te.b: Endemic species natural distribution ఒక defined regionకే restricted; native species అక్కడ naturally ఉన్నా elsewhere కూడా ఉండవచ్చు
options_te.c: Endemic అంటే people introduce చేసిన species

explanation_en: Red sanders is endemic to the southern Eastern Ghats, a stronger geographic restriction than merely being native.
explanation_te: Red sanders southern Eastern Ghatsకు endemic. ఇది merely native కంటే stronger geographic restriction.
